snippet.title: Kitty Finder | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Kitty Finder is a cozy hidden object game where cats love to hide in plain sight. Each scene is carefully illustrated and filled with small details that reward slow and relaxed exploration. Your goal is simple find all the hidden cats by observing the environment and paying attention to every corner.

This demo trailer shows the core gameplay of Kitty Finder including hand drawn cozy environments, relaxing hidden object mechanics, and playful cats with their own personalities. There are no timers or pressure. The game is designed to be calm, accessible, and enjoyable at your own pace.

Kitty Finder is perfect for players who enjoy cozy games, hidden object games, cat games, and relaxing puzzle experiences. If you like slow paced gameplay and visual discovery, this game is made for you.

The demo is available on Steam. If you enjoy what you see, consider wishlisting the game to support development. Your feedback helps shape the final experience.
